title: A Busy Afternoon in the City

sentences.text_target: It is a very busy afternoon in the city.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə ˈvɛri ˈbɪzi ˈɑftərnun ɪn ðə ˈsɪti/
sentences.text_native: C'est un après-midi très animé en ville.

sentences.text_target: David has an important meeting at his new office.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdeɪvɪd hæz ən ɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈmitɪŋ æt hɪs nu ˈɔfɪs/
sentences.text_native: David a une réunion importante dans son nouveau bureau.

sentences.text_target: He looks at his watch every single minute.
sentences.phonetic: /hi lʊks æt hɪz wɑtʃ ˈɛvəri ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈmɪnɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il regarde sa montre à chaque minute.

sentences.text_target: He does not want to be late today.
sentences.phonetic: /hi dʌz nɑt wɑnt tu bi leɪt təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il ne veut pas être en retard aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: Suddenly, David feels very worried.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsʌdənli, ˈdeɪvɪd filz ˈvɛri ˈwɜrid/
sentences.text_native: Soudain, David se sent très inquiet.

sentences.text_target: He checks his smartphone in his pocket.
sentences.phonetic: /hi tʃɛks hɪz ˈsmɑrtfoʊn ɪn hɪz ˈpɑkɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il vérifie son smartphone dans sa poche.

sentences.text_target: Oh no, the battery is completely dead.
sentences.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, ðə ˈbætəri ɪz kəmˈplitli dɛd/
sentences.text_native: Oh non, la batterie est complètement déchargée.

sentences.text_target: He cannot use the digital map anymore.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈkænɑt juz ðə ˈdɪdʒɪtəl mæp ˈɛniˌmɔr/
sentences.text_native: Il ne peut plus utiliser la carte numérique.

sentences.text_target: David walks fast on the crowded sidewalk.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdeɪvɪd wɔks fæst ɑn ðə ˈkraʊdɪd ˈsaɪdwɔk/
sentences.text_native: David marche vite sur le trottoir bondé.

sentences.text_target: He reaches a big street corner.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈritʃɪz ə bɪɡ strit ˈkɔrnər/
sentences.text_native: Il arrive à un grand coin de rue.

sentences.text_target: Many cars wait at the red traffic light.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈmɛni kɑrz weɪt æt ðə rɛd ˈtræfɪk laɪt/
sentences.text_native: De nombreuses voitures attendent au feu rouge.

sentences.text_target: A friendly pedestrian stands next to him.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈfrɛndli pəˈdɛstriən stændz nɛkst tu hɪm/
sentences.text_native: Un piéton sympathique se tient à côté de lui.

sentences.text_target: David decides to ask this person for help.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdeɪvɪd dɪˈsaɪdz tu æsk ðɪs ˈpɜrsən fɔr hɛlp/
sentences.text_native: David décide de demander de l'aide à cette personne.

sentences.text_target: Excuse me, can you help me please?
sentences.phonetic: /ɪkˈskyuz mi, kæn ju hɛlp mi pliz/
sentences.text_native: Excusez-moi, pouvez-vous m'aider s'il vous plaît ?

sentences.text_target: The smiling man turns and looks at him.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈsmaɪlɪŋ mæn tɜrnz ænd lʊks æt hɪm/
sentences.text_native: L'homme souriant se retourne et le regarde.

sentences.text_target: Yes, of course, what do you need?
sentences.phonetic: /jɛs, ʌv kɔrs, wʌt du ju nid/
sentences.text_native: Oui, bien sûr, de quoi avez-vous besoin ?

sentences.text_target: I am looking for the new business building.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈlʊkɪŋ fɔr ðə nu ˈbɪznəs ˈbɪldɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Je cherche le nouvel immeuble d'affaires.

sentences.text_target: It is on Baker Avenue near the old park.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɑn ˈbeɪkər ˈævənu nɪr ðə oʊld pɑrk/
sentences.text_native: Il est sur Baker Avenue près du vieux parc.

sentences.text_target: The man points straight ahead across the street.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə mæn pɔɪnts streɪt əˈhɛd əˈkrɔs ðə strit/
sentences.text_native: L'homme pointe tout droit devant lui de l'autre côté de la rue.

sentences.text_target: You need to cross this large avenue now.
sentences.phonetic: /ju nid tu krɔs ðɪs lɑrdʒ ˈævənu naʊ/
sentences.text_native: Vous devez traverser cette grande avenue maintenant.

sentences.text_target: Then walk straight for two blocks.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn wɔk streɪt fɔr tu blɑks/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, marchez tout droit pendant deux blocs.

sentences.text_target: You will walk past a yellow bakery.
sentences.phonetic: /ju wɪl wɔk pæst ə ˈjɛloʊ ˈbeɪkəri/
sentences.text_native: Vous passerez devant une boulangerie jaune.

sentences.text_target: A delicious smell of fresh bread comes from there.
sentences.phonetic: /ə dɪˈlɪʃəs smɛl ʌv frɛʃ brɛd kʌmz frʌm ðɛr/
sentences.text_native: Une délicieuse odeur de pain frais en provient.

sentences.text_target: David feels very hungry because he has no time for lunch.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdeɪvɪd filz ˈvɛri ˈhʌŋɡri bɪˈkɔz hi hæz noʊ taɪm fɔr lʌntʃ/
sentences.text_native: David a très faim car il n'a pas eu le temps de déjeuner.

sentences.text_target: After the bakery, turn left at the small bank.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈæftər ðə ˈbeɪkəri, tɜrn lɛft æt ðə smɔl bæŋk/
sentences.text_native: Après la boulangerie, tournez à gauche à la petite banque.

sentences.text_target: Your tall building is right behind the supermarket.
sentences.phonetic: /jʊər tɔl ˈbɪldɪŋ ɪz raɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈsupəˌmɑrkɪt/
sentences.text_native: Votre grand immeuble se trouve juste derrière le supermarché.

sentences.text_target: David listens carefully and smiles at the stranger.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdeɪvɪd ˈlɪsənz ˈkɛrfəli ænd smaɪlz æt ðə ˈstreɪndʒər/
sentences.text_native: David écoute attentivement et sourit à l'inconnu.

sentences.text_target: Thank you so much for your great help.
sentences.phonetic: /θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ fɔr jʊər ɡreɪt hɛlp/
sentences.text_native: Merci beaucoup pour votre aide précieuse.

sentences.text_target: You are very welcome, have a wonderful day.
sentences.phonetic: /ju ɑr ˈvɛri ˈwɛlkəm, hæv ə ˈwʌndərfəl deɪ/
sentences.text_native: De rien, passez une excellente journée.

sentences.text_target: Finally, David finds his destination just in time.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈfaɪnəli, ˈdeɪvɪd faɪndz hɪz ˌdɛstəˈneɪʃən dʒʌst ɪn taɪm/
sentences.text_native: Finalement, David trouve sa destination juste à temps.
